### Mentoring a struggling junior

- Situation: A new hire was three sprints behind and losing confidence.
- Task: I was asked to get them productive without burning them out.
- Action: We paired daily for two weeks and I broke work into one-day
  slices they could finish.
- Result: They shipped their first feature solo a month later.
- Lesson: Confidence compounds faster than skill.
- Tags: mentoring, leadership
